concerns.location: plan.md: Execution Plan Phase 0 / research.md Dataset Strategy
concerns.text: The plan names canonical sources (ACE SWEPAM/SWICS Level 2 via cdasws) but never names the actual CDAWeb dataset identifiers (e.g. AC_H0_SWE / AC_H2_SWE for SWEPAM, the SWICS Level 2 dataset id) that fetch_ace.py will request. The prior failure (T002 exit=2) was exactly a fetch-design problem; without the concrete dataset ids the re-planned fetch remains underspecified and risks a repeat failure. Add the CDAWeb dataset ids (and the specific NOAA SWPC / Kyoto WDC product file names) to the plan.

ACE SWICS He2+ abundance is known to have substantial data gaps and degraded coverage in the post-2011 era (SWICS instrument anomaly), which overlaps the entire 2018–2020 validation window. The plan's gap policy (interpolate ≤6 h, exclude >6 h) may leave helium_abundance largely excluded in the validation period, undermining the helium–Dst validation claim. The plan should acknowledge this coverage risk and state how the validation report will handle pairs with insufficient valid helium data.
